title: SIA PG v1.1.0 — Enterprise Privacy Guard & Live Stack Diagnostics
author: SIA PG Security Team
highlights: Automated stack trace analysis & sandbox verification
content:
### Enterprise Privacy & Live Diagnostics

Version 1.1.0 introduces **Live Diagnostics**, enabling SIA Code to automatically detect broken test assertions and propose verified patch solutions.

#### Improvements
- **Automated Stack Trace Parsing**: Resolves runtime exceptions instantly.
- **Local Fallback Mode**: Run lightweight models fully offline when disconnected from network.
